name: Read onboard temperature
description: Read the device's built-in temperature sensor — no extra wiring required.
setup_guide: This template returns `raw_value` and `temp_celsius` on every run. To see it on the dashboard: open the module, go to the Variables section, add a new variable named `temp_celsius` (Type: number), then attach a Gauge or Line Chart visualization with JSON Path `temp_celsius`, unit '°C', suggested min 0 / max 50.
